# Synthesized fixture, NOT a live capture.
#
# llm-d needs GPUs, a Gateway or standalone proxy, and model weights, so the EPP cannot run in CI. Metric
# names, types, HELP text, label names, and histogram bucket ladders are transcribed from upstream source:
#
#   llm-d/llm-d-router @ 7bdf81e1b121f730926824d66eee59e6f826a593 (main, after v1.0.0)
#     pkg/epp/metrics/llm_d_router_metrics.go                               request, pool, scheduler, plugin,
#                                                                            info, flow control, data layer
#     pkg/epp/metrics/streaming_histogram_buckets.go                        streaming TPOT and ITL ladders
#     pkg/epp/metrics/grpc_stream_metrics.go                                ext_proc streams
#     pkg/epp/metrics/collectors/inference_pool.go                          per-endpoint queue size and NIXL
#     pkg/epp/framework/plugins/scheduling/profilehandler/disagg/metrics.go disaggregation decisions
#     pkg/epp/framework/plugins/scheduling/filter/endpointhealth/metrics.go endpoint health
#     pkg/epp/framework/plugins/requesthandling/dataproducer/approximateprefix/metrics.go  prefix indexer
#     pkg/epp/framework/plugins/requesthandling/dataproducer/prefixmetrics/metrics.go      prefix prediction
#     pkg/epp/framework/plugins/requesthandling/dataproducer/inflightload/metrics.go       in-flight load
#     pkg/kvcache/metrics/collector.go                                      KV-cache index and events
#     pkg/common/observability/metrics/metrics.go                           shared bucket ladders
#
# request_outcome_total, scheduler_failures_total, datalayer_polls_total, datalayer_poll_duration_seconds,
# endpoint_health_*, and the api_surface label are newer than the v1.0.0 tag; every other family here is
# also emitted by v1.0.0. Label pairs are sorted by name, as the Prometheus Go client writes them.

# HELP llm_d_epp_flow_control_pool_saturation [ALPHA] Pool saturation signal gating Flow Control dispatch. The stage label partitions by pipeline role: 'prefill' and 'decode' are per-stage signals, 'effective' is max(prefill, decode) and is the value used for gating. 1.0 is the gating set point; values above 1.0 indicate the magnitude of oversubscription past it. An empty pool reads as 1.0. With the default utilization detector, endpoints with missing or stale metrics score as fully saturated under stalenessPolicy=saturated; see flow_control_stale_endpoints.
# TYPE llm_d_epp_flow_control_pool_saturation gauge
llm_d_epp_flow_control_pool_saturation{inference_pool="llama-3-1-8b-pool",stage="effective"} 0.6
